{{nihongo|'''Ōhirasan Shrine'''|太平山神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Shimotsuke Province]].

'''Ōhirasan Shrine''' (おおひらさんじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Tochigi (city)|Q44830|qid=Q44830}}, {{ill|Tochigi Prefecture|Q44843|qid=Q44843}}. Under the {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=former ranking system}}, it was a prefectural shrine.

=== Overview ===
The shrine stands at the summit of {{ill|Mount Ōhira|Q11443944|qid=Q11443944|lt=Mount Ōhira}}, and the stone staircase on the front approach has about 1,000 steps. It is said to have been founded in 827 by Jikaku Daishi ({{ill|Ennin|Q732282|qid=Q732282}})<ref>[http://www.kuranomachi.jp/spot/ohirasan/jinja/ Tochigi City Tourism Association]</ref>.

=== Main enshrined deities ===

=== Cultural properties ===
;Tangible cultural properties designated by the city
*Zuishin Gate (designated December 21, 1961)
**Ceiling painting "Dragon" (designated December 21, 1961)
*Main sanctuary (designated December 18, 2008)
*Worship hall (designated December 18, 2008)
*Hoshimiya Shrine building (designated December 18, 2008)

=== Other ===
The stone staircase on the approach is called Ajisai-zaka (Hydrangea Slope). Around 2,500 hydrangea plants of various kinds are planted there<ref>Yomiuri Shimbun, Tochigi edition, June 20, 2016, p.31.</ref>.

=== Access ===
*From {{ill|Tochigi Station|Q7811990|qid=Q7811990}}, about 15 minutes by {{ill|Kanto Transportation|Q11655986|qid=Q11655986|lt=Kantō Bus}} on the Kokugakuin Line; get off at "Kokugakuin."
*About 15 minutes from {{ill|Tochigi interchange|Q11110314|qid=Q11110314|lt=Tochigi IC}}
